test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the sister of B',

A - B means 'A is the husband of B',

A × B means 'A is the mother of B',

and A ÷ B means 'A is the brother of B'.

How is P related to T if 'P × Q ÷ R - S × T'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Husband
 Mother
 Brother
 
 

 
 to B
 
 

Given: P × Q ÷ R - S × T

P × Q → P is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a7061e175d41fb49e06e48c5cf23342c70b33dcaa21166520562354617b222e.png] 

Q ÷ R → Q is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d75c6f87663f7b6e12774da62128b28c047e6cc7ea9ade2bfd6c10a06ec04c0.png] 

R - S → R is the husband of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5b1ad5cce2480de0a0cee02f072b667af206dece2010c7df94c50d1f933ff45.png] 

S × T → S is the mother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b9d67878b1b284a3e9fd56de9df8e4a3a8f6220b5dac13d75a5a5c4fd0e058f.png] 

Thus, P is T's father's mother or paternal grandmother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
